name: @akurganow/model-router
description: Routes OpenClaw and Oh My Pi subagents to a small, middle or large model and an effort that fit the task.

provider.description: Whose model scores each subagent task: typesafe, openai or google.

gateway.description: How the provider is reached: direct (its own API only), auto (its own API, then OpenRouter), openrouter-first (OpenRouter, then its own API) or openrouter (OpenRouter only).

scope.description: Which subagents are routed: core (the default agents only) or extended (also other agents, as the README lists).

models.description: The scoring model per provider as provider:model entries for typesafe, openai or google, such as {typesafe:jev-latest, openai:gpt-6-luna}; a provider with no entry uses its default.
